correction.what_I_said: In the previous message I reported that six components -- pages, page-code, agency-net, echo, novora-helm, novora-suite -- have 'no tests at all'.
correction.why_it_was_wrong: My sweep counted only Python test_*.py files. Every one of those six ships a Node test suite (.test.mjs) that pytest cannot see. There are 27 .test.mjs suites in the tree, including hf-cohort/hf.test.mjs and cross-stack/github_pilot.test.mjs -- Hugging Face and GitHub cohort tests that already exist.
correction.the_class_of_error: Exactly the one the OQM blind-spot audit named: an instrument run outside its domain returns a true number with a false implication. pytest counted correctly; my conclusion did not follow.
correction.the_real_harness: reproduce_all.sh runs BOTH runtimes and is the only complete measure of this repo.

primary_verdict: 5/5. Three findings. FIRST, I was wrong last message: 27 Node test suites exist and all six components I called untested ship one -- my sweep counted only Python. SECOND, live Qwen/DeepSeek data CANNOT be fetched here: GitHub and Hugging Face are policy-blocked ({'api.github.com': '403', 'huggingface.co': '000'}), reported rather than worked around. THIRD, the committed cohorts cannot carry the requested comparison either -- DeepSeek appears EXACTLY ONCE across 992 GitHub repos and 24 HF models, which is ONE_WING, and the seven Qwen hits are community fine-tunes naming a Qwen base_model rather than Qwen releases. The stack itself reproduces in one offline command with every suite passing -- which means its bookkeeping is honest, not that its theories are confirmed.
